verdict.rationale: Temporal supports workflows-as-code with retries, signals, and Schedules for time-based triggering (temporal-docs-10, temporal-docs-15), and can be invoked from external events via API/signal calls, but it is not a declarative rules engine where an AI-native user defines event-condition-action rules directly — it requires writing workflow code rather than declarative trigger rules. missing for 10: a declarative rule-definition interface (no-code/low-code trigger authoring), native event-source bindings/webhooks for arbitrary external events, and evidence of AI-native users defining rules rather than developers writing workflow code.
